# AI for Babies
> AI Explained for People with Actual Jobs. High-contrast, developer-friendly engineering suite explaining LLMs, RAG architectures, Agent workflows, inference optimization, and marketing intelligence without corporate fluff.

## Core Capabilities & Interactive Modules
- [77 Essential AI Terms](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#dictionary): 77 categorized, deep-dive concepts covering Foundations, Prompting & Inference, RAG & Search, Agents & Multi-Agent, Performance & Speed, Evals & Benchmarks, and Protocols & WebMCP.
- [Prompt Engine](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#prompt-engine): Diagnostic tool analyzing prompt quality against 8 production engineering rules.
- [RAG Masterclass](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#rag-course): Hybrid BM25+Dense search, Cross-Encoder rerankers, and contextual retrieval pipelines.
- [AGENTS.md Generator](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#agents-spec): Linux Foundation standard specification generator for autonomous coding agent governance.
- [100k Tool Scaling](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#tool-scaling): Skill paging pattern and RAM memory management for massive toolsets.
- [Speculative Decoding Lab](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#speculative-decoding): Mathematical simulator bypassing GPU DRAM memory bandwidth bottlenecks.
- [Agent Gym](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#agent-gym): Synthetic task generation and Harbour evaluation frameworks.
- [WebMCP Protocol Scanner](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#webmcp-scanner): Browser-side agent tools and client runtime integrations.
- [Marketing Intelligence Layer](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#marketing-intelligence): 4-stage confidential knowledge distillation pipeline.
- [AI Spec PRD Framework](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#spec-prd): Structured specification framework bridging product intent and agent execution.
